# Shared Project Context

## Tech Stack
- TypeScript ESM monorepo managed by pnpm workspaces (`pnpm-workspace.yaml`)
- `@officexr/sdk` — headless, DOM-free, React-free: Zustand store, Bus, Actions, SyncEngine, SnapshotHandshake, InMemoryChannel, SupabaseChannel, FakeClock, MultiClientHarness
- `@officexr/core-refactor` — headless library: VoiceAdapter interface, Communication class, deriveJitsiRoom, MockVoiceAdapter
- `@officexr/core` — legacy React app (Three.js, RoomScene, useJitsi, usePresence) — **do not modify**
- Three.js for 3D rendering; Vite for build tooling; React 18 for UI

## Test Infrastructure
- **Framework**: Vitest (v4.x)
- **Test command**: `pnpm test` (within each package, runs `vitest run`); or `pnpm --filter @officexr/sdk test`, `pnpm --filter @officexr/core-refactor test`, `pnpm --filter @officexr/debug-app test`
- **File conventions**: `*.test.ts` files co-located alongside source or in `src/__tests__/` subdirectories
- **TDD applies to**: headless logic tasks (factory, LocalVoiceAdapter, bot driver, integration test). Skip for renderer/UI/visual tasks.
- **vitest.config.ts pattern**: `{ test: { environment: 'node', globals: true, include: ['src/**/*.test.ts'], passWithNoTests: true } }`

## Conventions
- All packages use `"type": "module"` — ESM-only, `.ts` extension in imports (e.g. `import ... from './foo.ts'`)
- Exports defined via `"exports"` field in `package.json`; workspace references via `workspace:*`
- Class-based architecture for stateful subsystems (SyncEngine, Communication); plain functions for pure utilities
- No React in `@officexr/sdk`; no DOM/MediaStream in `@officexr/sdk`
- TypeScript `strict` mode; no `any` except where bridging external APIs
